items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: they used to cut the pigeon wing that was there by Frank Theod.

ctx.x: Now, where Old Man John of Conjean, they used to cut the pigeon wing that was there by Frank Theod. Right next to the grocery unit, they had that little hole there and the church was next to it. The Catholic Church was next to it.
The Catholic Church was next to it.
